lead.headline: ULA's Vulcan rocket fails, losing 40 Amazon internet satellites
lead.dek: The Centaur upper stage faltered 10 minutes after Sunday's Cape Canaveral liftoff, the first total loss for ULA since it formed in 2006
body: A United Launch Alliance Vulcan rocket carrying 40 Amazon Leo broadband satellites failed about 10 minutes after lifting off at 12:40 p.m. ET Sunday from Cape Canaveral Space Force Station, Fla. ULA said the vehicle "suffered an anomaly 10 minutes into the flight and failed to deliver the Amazon mission to orbit," the first outright failure of a ULA rocket since the Boeing-Lockheed Martin venture formed in 2006.

Telemetry on ULA's webcast showed the six solid boosters separating on time, the two BE-4 first-stage engines burning past the published timeline and the Centaur upper stage making unusual attitude adjustments early in its burn, CBS News reported. ULA has not given a cause; it said it will find one, take corrective action and return to flight "as quickly as possible." Amazon called ULA "a trusted partner."

The flight was Vulcan's fifth and its first in nine months, after solid-booster nozzle problems on two earlier missions led the Space Force to pause national-security launches. It was the first of 38 Vulcan flights Amazon bought for a constellation that needs more than 3,300 satellites; 396 had launched before Sunday, Spaceflight Now reported, and Amazon also holds launches on New Glenn, Ariane 6 and Falcon 9.

briefs.headline: Cassidy says Kennedy has presided over a 'series of failures'
briefs.summary: The outgoing Republican senator who secured the health secretary's confirmation said Sunday he would now pick someone else, citing measles deaths and rising health costs.

briefs.headline: Trump vows expedited appeal of judge's golf course halt
briefs.summary: Trump called Judge Ana Reyes's order blocking Sunday's closure of East Potomac Golf Links for redevelopment "highly destructive and political"; the order runs to Nov. 28.

briefs.headline: NTSB says tanker's steering failed before New Orleans crash
briefs.summary: Investigators said Sunday the Atlantic Asphalt's rudder stuck to starboard about two minutes before it hit the riverboat American Heritage on Friday; six people remain hospitalized.

briefs.headline: Duffy says he 'can't cancel' L3Harris as FAA network owner
briefs.summary: The transportation secretary said Sunday the contractor blamed for Friday's ground stop owns the network; the administration is asking Congress for $30 billion to replace it.

briefs.headline: Estonia moves to close its Russia border crossings Dec. 1
briefs.summary: Estonia will shut its three crossings with Russia after an attempted arson at drone maker Threod that Tallinn says Russia's GRU ordered, the Kyiv Independent reported Sunday.

briefs.headline: Bahrain says it downed Iranian drones as a third US carrier arrives
briefs.summary: Bahrain's defense force said it intercepted Sunday's attacks after the IRGC claimed a six-drone strike on a U.S. radar at Riffa; the USS Theodore Roosevelt joined two carriers in the region.

briefs.headline: ASEAN and China fail to finish a South China Sea code
briefs.summary: Philippine Foreign Secretary Theresa Lazaro said Sunday the sides agreed on about 80% of a draft but reached "no conclusion"; Singapore takes over the talks in 2027.

briefs.headline: Cape Verde's Neves wins a second term, provisional tally shows
briefs.summary: Incumbent Jose Maria Neves took about 64% to Joana Rosa's 31.5% with 98% of Sunday's vote counted, on turnout of about 32%, removing the need for a Nov. 29 runoff.

briefs.headline: Supreme Court won't seat de Soto, says Democrats lack standing
briefs.summary: In an opinion reported Sunday, Chief Justice Bunn wrote the court cannot redress the injury because seating him would mean unseating Del. Ian Masters; de Soto still awaits trial on threat charges.

briefs.headline: State to let parents with LLCs qualify for child care subsidy
briefs.summary: A Morrisey spokesperson said the revision adding LLCs as eligible self-employment should be done in early December, West Virginia Watch reported Saturday; such parents had been barred since 2007.
briefs.source: West Virginia Watch via The Herald-Dispatch

briefs.headline: DEP starts $11.6M stabilization at the burning White Hall mine
briefs.summary: Thaxton Construction of Charleston won the contract to stabilize Nellie Lane and build a retaining wall over a 100-year-old Marion County mine where fire reemerged in July 2025; two homes were bought out.

regional.item: The Cabell County Courthouse is closed today for a water main leak; other county offices stay open, the commission said.
Teamsters Local 175 sent The Beverage Market a member-ratified contract offer Sunday after six months on the Sissonville picket line.
WV 14 at Green Street in Wood County closes for paving from 7 a.m. to 6:30 p.m. Tuesday through Thursday.

away.item: Pre-K pupils at the Village School of North Bennington met "Stormin' Normin'" on Nov. 10, the state plow they named for the village highway chief.

hotspots.item: WVDOT came to Upperglade on Nov. 6 to honor the Webster County High student whose Highlander-themed plow blade won the statewide Paint the Plow vote.
Pender schools hold a Tuesday 6 p.m. forum at Topsail High on draft maps that would move 1,200-plus elementary and up to 1,125 middle-school pupils.

briefs.headline: Three councillors move to pause the $15.8M CN Centre repair
briefs.summary: Couns. Trudy Klassen, Bob Radloff and James Steidle ask Prince George council tonight to halt the building-envelope project pending an independent cost review.

briefs.headline: BC Hydro restores power to Zeballos after eight days
briefs.summary: Power returned to 203 customers in the Vancouver Island village at 3:17 p.m. Sunday, ending an outage that began Nov. 7; crews rappelled in by helicopter for the repair.

briefs.headline: Peace region leaders press for a seat in Doerkson's cabinet
briefs.summary: With the B.C. Conservative cabinet to be sworn in Friday, regional district chair Brad Sperling said Sunday he wants an energy minister from the northeast.

briefs.headline: Canada's exports to China rise almost 40% ahead of Xi talks
briefs.summary: Statistics Canada data show $33.5 billion in exports from January to September, up $9.5 billion; Carney meets Xi in Shenzhen as the canola-for-steel deal is extended to 2028.

briefs.headline: Warming can keep rising after emissions stop, model finds
briefs.summary: A Met Office-led study in Nature Climate Change, reported Sunday, finds halting CO2 at 3 to 5 C of warming adds 0.4 to 0.6 C over 150 years; at 2 C or below, temperatures hold steady.

briefs.headline: China's 19-seat electric airliner makes its first crewed flight
briefs.summary: COMAC says its CE-25A battery-electric commuter plane flew with two pilots and an engineer Saturday in Shandong after 19 uncrewed tests; the 400 km range is the company's own figure.

briefs.headline: Leonid meteor shower peaks tonight under a setting moon
briefs.summary: NASA puts the peak on the night of Nov. 16-17 at fewer than three meteors an hour in dark skies; the American Meteor Society says activity tops out Nov. 18, after the first-quarter moon sets.

briefs.headline: JWST data undercut claim of an outsize early black hole
briefs.summary: Mid-infrared limits reported Sunday suggest any black hole in the galaxy UHZ1 is 10 to 1,000 times fainter than claimed, and that UHZ1 is likely a star-forming galaxy, the Astrophysical Journal study finds.

briefs.headline: Hong Kong switches on facial recognition across its CCTV network
briefs.summary: Police activated AI face-matching Monday on the roughly 5,000-camera SmartView system, with 60,000 cameras planned by 2028; Commissioner Joe Chow said the tools "will not be used casually."

briefs.headline: Fed survey ranks AI as the top risk to financial stability
briefs.summary: In its Financial Stability Report released Friday, the Fed says AI was the most-cited risk among 23 market contacts, who named equity valuations, AI-enabled cyberattacks and AI-linked financing.

briefs.headline: Firm tied to Huang's ex-partner brokered $12B in Nvidia chips, WSJ reports
briefs.summary: The Decoder relayed a Wall Street Journal report Sunday that Singapore-based Megaspeed arranged nearly $12 billion in Nvidia chip orders for Chinese buyers in 2024-25; Megaspeed says its business was lawful.

weather_ear: Monday's forecast from Jim Claudtore lands at 7:15.
kicker: Nicholas-Webster and Summers-New River carry no regional line today; PAHO briefs reporters Tuesday on the United States' measles elimination status.

art.caption: A Vulcan rocket climbs clear of its Cape Canaveral pad between the lightning masts Sunday, moments into the flight that failed.
art.credit: Sketched from a CBS News photograph
